preconditions.description: x is a string consisting of alphabetic characters only.

postconditions.description: The length of the result is the same as the length of the input string x.

postconditions.expression: all(word_inside_out(word) == result[i] for i, word in enumerate(x.split()))
postconditions.description: Each word in the result is the 'inside out' version of the corresponding word in the input string.
